svg.text: HAXĀ — WHAT THE ORIGINAL MODEL WAS MISSING, AND HOW IT IS RESOLVED
Same cut plane (through the crown axis), same scale. Top: the original model as found. Bottom: the 2026 model. Findings are measured on the meshes.
ORIGINAL SOURCE — as modelled
2026 MODEL — engineered around Sellita SW300-1
FINDINGS → 2026 MODEL
Case is a solid block: rays down the axis cross only its bottom (−6.10) and top
(+0.11). No cavity, caseback or crystal seat.
→ Bore Ø32.20, bezel counterbore, caseback thread, crown-tube hole cut. 2118 of
3023 exterior vertices checked: all still on the surface.
Crystal is a 0.22 mm sheet, flush with the bezel top.
→ 1.20 mm sapphire Ø33.00, fitted from inside under a 0.50 mm bezel lip.
60 pillars pass 0.11 mm into the crystal.
→ Pillars kept at full source height and radius; 0.093 mm below the crystal.
Bezel overlaps the case solid from −0.01 to +1.22.
→ Bezel press-fits into a Ø34.60 counterbore on a gasket.
Hands: minute hand below the hour hand and overlapping it in height; every piece
present twice; hub holes ≈Ø0.74.
→ Hour at Sellita F 0.80, minute at E 1.20 above the dial seat; 0.180 mm between
them; collets on Ø1.50 / Ø0.90.
Figure solids reach 0.60 mm below the dial's underside.
→ Trimmed at dial seat +0.05 (appliqué feet to detail).
Crown axis at −3.00, no tube, no stem, no movement to drive.
→ Crown moved down 0.168 mm onto the SW300-1 stem axis; tube Ø2.50; crown gap
No movement, so no stack to check.
→ SW300-1 envelope + casing ring; rotor security 0.50 (worst 0.40) in Sellita's
A stray 0.07 mm plate floats 1.3 mm above the dial in the minute-hand tip zone
(object R01217).
→ Removed.
Bracelet end links sit up to 0.29 mm inside the case; no pin or spring bar enters
the lugs.
→ End links, spring bars, clasp: sizing, strength open.
OPEN ITEMS (not claimed)
• Phantom date: SW300-1 carries a date; the HAXĀ dial has no window. Source a no-date
execution or accept a dead crown position.
• Bracelet end links, spring bars and clasp: sizing and strength not checked.
• Casing clamps, thread profiles and gasket grooves are shown simplified; tolerances
not yet assigned.
• Water resistance 5 bar (ISO 22810:2010) is a design target: no pressure calculation
or test.
• Dial-art layering (stones set into the figure, stacked wing layers) is modelled as
overlapping solids; split into manufacturable appliqués with feet.
MALINYX · HAXĀ
Source audit → 2026 model
SHEET 2/2 · A3 · mm
2026-10-02 · concept engineering
not released for manufacture
